04.04 Effects of Publication 
a) Upon publication, the Patent Office makes the specification 
(complete as well as provisional, if any), abstract, draw ings and 
any other document s filed in respect of the application available 
to the public on its website and copies of the same can also 
be made available on payment of the prescribed fee as given in 
the First Schedule of Patents Rules 2003 (as ame nded), if such a 
request is filed.
